name: Mary Magdalene
title: Witness to the Resurrection
summary: Mary Magdalene was one of Jesus' most faithful followers. Jesus had driven seven evil spirits out of her, and she followed him along with other women who supported his ministry. She was present at the cross, at the tomb, and became the first to see the risen Jesus.

keyEvents.title: Deliverance
keyEvents.description: Jesus drove seven evil spirits out of Mary Magdalene, and she then followed him faithfully and supported his ministry financially.

keyEvents.title: At the Foot of the Cross
keyEvents.description: Mary Magdalene was among the women who stood at the cross and watched Jesus die.

keyEvents.title: At the Tomb
keyEvents.description: Mary Magdalene was present when Jesus was laid in the tomb and noted where he was placed.

keyEvents.title: The Empty Tomb
keyEvents.description: Early in the morning, Mary Magdalene came to the tomb and found it empty. She ran to tell Peter and John.

keyEvents.title: Meeting the Risen One
keyEvents.description: Mary wept at the tomb when Jesus appeared to her. She recognized him when he said her name and became the first to proclaim the resurrection.
